him going。您能够解决Going的功能吗?对,Going是用于描述他所做的任务。在这种情况下,NG的词汇是一个任务。您能够找到这个词汇的任务吗?他们找到了一个词汇,终于把问题解决了。对,Solved是用于一个任务。它描述了任务的问题。我们可以看到NG和ED的词汇可以用于任务来描述词汇的问题。现在来看另一个例子。读者听到他在课堂里实行他的言论。在这个词汇中,读者用于描述他的言论是什么?对,用于描述词汇的词汇。所以我们可以叫这种课堂为Subject Compliment。您能够找到Subject Compliment在这句话中吗?连续读者很满意结果结果的比赛。对,Satisfied是用于Subject Compliment来描述词汇的问题。所以NG和ED的词汇可以用于Subject Compliment来描述词汇的问题。您能够找到NG和ED的词汇用于Subject Compliment吗?请继续读下来的词汇并找到Subject Compliment或Subject Compliment的词汇。您能够找到NG和ED的词汇吗?请继续读下来的词汇。现在让我们查试一下。第一,他发现了在一条中心园的故事非常令人兴奋。Here exciting is used to describe the object, the story, so it is used as an, yes, object complement.Tired describes the subject, the physician, so it is a subject complement.Here turned down describes what happened to the object, her suggestions, so it serves as an object complement.Writing describes what the subject, the child, was doing, so it is used as a subject complement.From these sentences, we can also discover, find somebody doing or done is a common structure where ING or ED forms of verbs are used as complements.Can you think of other verbs with similar use?Good, we have, see, watch, observe, notice, look at, hear, listen to, feel.Actually, these are all perception verbs.In Chinese, 感官动词。Besides, ING or ED forms of verbs used as complements also follow causative verbs.In Chinese, 使意动词, such as get, make, have, keep, leave, etc.And the complements are also used in the structure, with somebody doing or with something done.But when should we use the ING form to function as complements, and when should we use the ED form to serve as complements?To solve this puzzle, let's take a close look at these two sentences.Now discuss the differences between these two sentences with your partner.In these two sentences, the objects are jobs.But in sentence 1, the object complement talking about him describes what the object jobs was doing, which is active in meaning.While in sentence 2, the object complement talked about describes what happened to the object jobs, which has passive meaning.So can we draw the conclusion now?当被补充说明的主语或宾语与该动词形成主动的逻辑关系时,我们用 ING 分词做补语。而当被补充说明的主语或宾语与该动词形成被动的逻辑关系时,我们用 ED 分词做补语。To see whether you really understand the differences, let's do some practice.Turn to page 9 and finish exercise 2.While filling in the blanks, identify whether the ING or ED forms of the verbs function as object complement or subject complements.We will have one minute to finish this exercise.Now let's have a check.In sentence 1, we need an object complement to describe the object, his new novel.What will happen to his new novel?Yes, his new novel will be displayed, so we should fill in the ED form displayed.Number 2, we still need an object complement to describe the object.So, his heart was beating, we fill in beating.Number 3, we fill in going, as an object complement to describe the object me.Number 4, we fill in closed.What's the function of closed?Right, still an object complement to describe the object eyes.Number 5, what did you fill in?Correct, doing.What's the function of this doing?Yes, a subject complement to describe the subject, the professor.Now look at the sentences on the screen.Complete these sentences with the ING or ED forms of verbs as complement.According to your understanding of Job's speech, you can discuss with your partner.Thank you for watching.Here are some possible versions.One, Job felt himself honored when giving the speech.Two, when they designed the first computer, they had calligraphy designed in it.Number three, Job must have been upset when he heard himself.So, what did you fill in?Okay, I fill in fired by Apple.Four, the whole family were in deep sorrow when they found Job diagnosed with cancer or you may fill in facing death.Number five, Steve Jobs told us three stories to make.We can fill in himself understood or his listeners interested in this speech.To consolidate what we have learned, I'd like you to finish exercise three on page nine.Time is up, everyone.Let's check together.Number one, at the age of seven, she was sold as a slave.Number two, one day she was found riding on the wall with chalk.Number three, she read a lot of books and found them inspiring.Which one's function as object complements or subject complements?Writing describes the subject, Phyllis, and inspiring describes them, the object.So, it is an object complement.After reading this paragraph, can you tell me what Phyllis Wheatley was?Correct, she was a poet.Now let's go on to read the following paragraphs and find out more about her life experiences.Number four, she got a collection of 39 poems published.Five, with her talent recognized, she became honored and respected.Can you find which ones are complements?Yes, published is used as an object complement to describe the object, a collection of 39 poems.And recognize also serves as an object complement to describe the object, her talent.Now let's move on to her later life.In 1778, she got married, but with things getting worse, she had to move back to Boston.Are there any complements?Yes, getting, an object complement.I'm sure after reading her story, you must have had a brief idea about her life
